scope: Independent source/output review of canonical constructor runner and four-line hosted CI integration only. Accepted R1576/R1578 constructor/test semantics not re-reviewed.

checks.name: CI sparse inputs and dependency ordering
checks.conclusion: Non-cone /hosted/ sparse input includes runner, nine required modules and test. Root-relative step follows locked dependency resolution and uses hosted/deps/jason/lib. Jason archive hash in adoption matches the locked 1.4.5 package. Pinned Elixir 1.20.4/OTP29 matches observed local replay. MIX_ENV:test on preceding step is step-local; runner explicitly selects prod.

checks.name: Current formatted runner and production output
checks.conclusion: Current runner and workflow hashes match formattedReplay. Actual stdout records prod, OTP29/Elixir1.20.4, ten Jason sources, 12 total/0 failures/0 skipped/0 excluded and no production activation. All ten source/test identities match current canonical bytes. Command records agree with receipt and report exit0, direct reap, both EOFs, closed descriptors and group absence. Runner loads only explicit dependencies, initializes public_key, runs ExUnit and exits nonzero on failure, skip or total !=12.

checks.name: Production and ordinary test compatibility
checks.conclusion: New lib module compiles under both lib-only production and lib+test/support test paths. Test uses public constructor/configuration APIs and public_key CA loading. Installation.load! configured refusal and disabled branch are outside its test-only fixture definitions, so test assertion applies in both modes. Existing broad mix test discovers added *_test.exs; test-local manifest records additive files and compares before/after rather than enforcing a closed repository file count. No lifecycle/startup code changed.

checks.name: Existing strict selected-source runner
checks.conclusion: Independently read all 272 named v15 inputs and matched every byte-size/hash to selected manifest. Constructor, test and runner are unselected additions. --check-source builds observed map by iterating ORDINARY_BROWSER_MANIFEST; runtime obtains sorted explicit manifest Git blobs. Neither demands total filesystem membership. Protocol runner likewise uses explicit source list. Strict authority remains unchanged; added files do not expand or invalidate it.
